# configuration file /etc/nginx/nginx.conf:
events {
}

http {
    include /etc/nginx/conf.d/*.conf;
}
# configuration file /etc/nginx/conf.d/legacy.conf:
server {
    listen 443;
    listen 127.0.0.1:8443 ssl http2;
    listen unix:/run/nginx-tls.sock ssl;
    server_name legacy.example.com;
    ssl on;
    ssl_certificate     ssl/legacy-a.crt;
    ssl_certificate_key ssl/legacy-a.key;
    ssl_certificate     ssl/legacy-b.crt;
    ssl_certificate_key ssl/legacy-b.key;
}

server {
    listen 80;
    server_name cleartext.example.com;
    ssl off;
    ssl_certificate ssl/unused.crt;
    ssl_certificate_key ssl/unused.key;
}
